svg.title: Receding-horizon CEM-MPC planning loop
svg.desc: Diagram of LeWorldModel's closed-loop control cycle. An arrow from the environment's current observation enters an encoder box that produces the context latent z_t. Both z_t and the precomputed goal latent z_goal feed into a CEM planner box. Inside the planner is an inner loop labelled "30 iterations: sample 300 action sequences, predict 5 latents ahead using the learned predictor, score each sequence by squared distance to z_goal, keep the top 30 elites, refit the sampling Gaussian." The planner emits a single first action a_t; that action is applied in the environment, producing a new observation, and the loop restarts. The remaining four planned actions are discarded each step.
